en-US.title: Dalee
en-US.subtitle: Five word games, daily
en-US.description:
Dalee is the daily word circuit — five bite-size word games, one fresh set every day. Everyone plays the same puzzles, so it's you against the day, your friends, and the Game Center leaderboards.

Play the full circuit in about 25 minutes:

• Wordle — guess the five-letter word in six tries
• Scramble — unscramble the jumbled letters
• Ladder — change one letter at a time to reach the target
• Mini Crossword — solve a tiny clue grid
• Blitz — find as many words as you can in 60 seconds

Rack up your daily score, build your streak, unlock achievements, share your result, and compare your run on daily, weekly, and yearly Game Center leaderboards. Beautifully designed, quick to play, and endlessly replayable.

— Five word games in one daily circuit
— A fresh set of puzzles every day
— Daily, weekly, and yearly Game Center leaderboards
— Achievements, challenges, sharing, and streaks
— Gorgeous, distraction-free design
— Free to play
en-US.promoText: Mini Crossword joins the daily circuit, with tighter live scoring, fresh play-for-fun puzzles, Game Center leaderboards, achievements, and sharing.
en-US.releaseNotes: Adds Mini Crossword, fresh play-for-fun puzzles, live score controls, per-game score breakdowns, smoother next-game navigation, duplicate-free daily puzzle selection, a 4 AM Eastern daily rollover, tighter tie-resistant scoring with a 100-point game floor, and expanded Game Center achievements.
